description: Add end-to-end tests from staged fixture bytes through blob upload and image post publication. Prove retry and restart idempotency for both blob and post effects. Verify that dry-run creates no remote writes, alt text is required, unsafe or oversized inputs fail before upload, and existing text drafts still work. Document operator commands, configuration, limits, cleanup, and the stable API that a later ReqLLM generation flow will call.
title: Verify and document the image plumbing boundary
